- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment periods (sentiment < 0.3) — raise forecast lows.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast peaks at 1–2% below true peak.
- Lagged price movements often over-predict short-term reversals — adjust forecast 3–5 days ahead downward if sentiment shifts from bullish to neutral.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate volatility in early periods — dampen early forecast spikes if sentiment is weak or mixed.
